object.attr: derived: the parameter's name reads as a git revision, so an agent passing a tag, a hash or HEAD~2 expects that version and gets the working copy labelled with it (CF-P5). Decided on 2026-11-11 (failure analysis Q1).
object.description: If the MCP server's export tool is given a revision label that git's revision syntax resolves to a commit, the MCP server shall refuse the export.
